SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name,
d.type AS deposit_type, d.min_term AS deposit_min_term, d.max_term AS deposit_max_term, d.saving_min, d.saving_max, d.min_rate, d.max_rate,
dr.id AS rate_id, dr.deposit_id AS rate_deposit_id, dr.min_term AS rate_min_term, dr.max_term AS rate_max_term, dr.base_rate
FROM product p
INNER JOIN deposit d ON p.id = d.id
LEFT JOIN deposit_rate dr ON d.id = dr.deposit_id
ORDER BY p.id, dr.min_term

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name,
d.type AS deposit_type, d.min_term AS deposit_min_term, d.max_term AS deposit_max_term, d.saving_min, d.saving_max, d.min_rate, d.max_rate,
dr.id AS rate_id, dr.deposit_id AS rate_deposit_id, dr.min_term AS rate_min_term, dr.max_term AS rate_max_term, dr.base_rate
FROM product p
INNER JOIN deposit d ON p.id = d.id
LEFT JOIN deposit_rate dr ON d.id = dr.deposit_id
WHERE d.type = #{type}
ORDER BY p.id, dr.min_term

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.url, p.company_name,
d.type AS deposit_type, d.min_term AS deposit_min_term, d.max_term AS deposit_max_term, d.saving_min, d.saving_max, d.min_rate, d.max_rate,
dr.id AS rate_id, dr.deposit_id AS rate_deposit_id, dr.min_term AS rate_min_term, dr.max_term AS rate_max_term, dr.base_rate
FROM product p
INNER JOIN deposit d ON p.id = d.id
LEFT JOIN deposit_rate dr ON d.id = dr.deposit_id
WHERE p.id = #{productId}
ORDER BY dr.min_term

SELECT dr.id, dr.deposit_id, dr.min_term, dr.max_term, dr.base_rate
FROM deposit_rate dr
INNER JOIN deposit d ON dr.deposit_id = d.id
WHERE dr.deposit_id = #{productId}
AND #{term} >= dr.min_term
AND ( dr.max_term IS NULL OR #{term} <= dr.max_term )
AND #{term} >= d.min_term AND #{term} <= d.max_term
ORDER BY dr.min_term DESC
LIMIT 1
